question: As on November 2022, who is the first citizen of India?
solution:
The correct answer is **Droupadi Murmu**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__The President of India__ is called first citizen of India.

__
 
• He is also commander-in-chief of the Indian Armed Forces.
 
• The president is indirectly elected by a college of electors comprising the Indian Parliament (both houses) and the legislative assemblies of each of India's states and territories, all directly elected.
 
• He is the nation's legislative Head.
 
• As a citizen of India, a common man ranks in 27th place.
 
• The President of India is called the Nominal head.
 
• The President resides in an estate known as the Rashtrapati Bhavan (President's House) situated in Raisina Hill in New Delhi.

Droupadi Murmu 

 
• ​Droupadi Murmu was elected the 15th President of India.
 
• Since July 25, 2022, Droupadi Murmu, also known as Puti Biranchi Tudu, has held the office of India's 15th president.
 
• She was born on June 20, 1958. After Pratibha Patil, she is the second woman to hold the position and the first member of a tribal community to do so.
 
• Along with being the first President born in Independent India, she is also the youngest person to hold the position. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Citizen of India as per the Order of Precedence of the Republic of India:

 
• Citizen No.1: President.
 
• Citizen No. 2: Vice-President.
 
• Citizen No. 3: Prime Minister.
 
• Citizen No.4: Governors (within their respective states).
 
• Citizen No.5: Former Presidents.
 
• Citizen No. 5A: Deputy Prime Minister.
 
• Citizen No.6: Chief Justice of India, Speaker of Lok Sabha
